hooks.text: 深入互联网会持续侵蚀数字理智，玩家可能听见不存在的脚步、把队友看成敌人或幻视陷阱
hooks.excerpt: As you delve deeper into the digital areas, your crew's mental state will deteriorate. The mind plays tricks on you. When the madness sets in, you might hear footsteps that aren't there, see your friends as the enemy, or hallucinate traps.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 程序生成的网络沙盒从滤镜社交平台延伸到暗网，每个平台以酸雨、防火墙激光和故障喷泉塑造独立威胁
hooks.excerpt: Enter to the procedurally generated sandbox realms of the modern net! From hyper-filtered social feeds to the terrifying Dark Web, every run is unique. Each platform has a deadly personality and scaling difficulty. Survive cancel-culture acid rain, dodge firewall lasers over lava pits, and navigate erupting glitch geysers.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 不只逃避异常，还能反过来黑入环境陷阱、引爆隐藏逻辑炸弹并启用平台武器清除怪物
hooks.excerpt: Don't just run from anomalies, use the internet against them! Hack complex environmental traps, trigger hidden logic bombs, or activate platform-specific weapons to obliterate glitch-mutated creatures.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
